scope: UX-02 bounded public discovery, intake and identity presentation acceptance

tests.baseline: Public discovery and corridor scope pages; existing mission job catalogue and intake query parameters
tests.implementation: PublicShell and DiscoveryExperience; Atlas, perspective/job selectors and read-only synthetic walkthrough
tests.positive: UX-02 Atlas selects an actual direction and synthetic example without creating records
tests.negative: Same test: no writes or identity grant, EU remains a bloc, reverse direction has no announced operating offer

tests.baseline: 24-hour session draft, original job/country/market/source text and currency
tests.implementation: Saved choices take precedence over link hints; draft/expiry recovery and brief context summary
tests.positive: UX-02 saved draft choices survive reload and take precedence over entry suggestions
tests.negative: UX-02 expired and corrupt drafts recover to a usable form without claiming admission; UX-02 blocked draft storage is visible and does not discard current form entries

tests.baseline: Anonymous five-step adaptive intake, idempotent synthetic mission creation and private receipt reads
tests.implementation: Progress, input recovery, original amount summary and failed receipt lookup clearing previous result
tests.positive: UX-02 discovery completes a synthetic brief with original money, retry, duplicate and receipt denial semantics
tests.negative: Same test: invalid travel dates, real email refused before network, injected interruption, duplicate retry through real service and nonexistent receipt denial

tests.baseline: Customer Neon Auth SDK methods, input validation, independent identity and sealed account/operator distinction
tests.implementation: Shared account shell, verified-own-profile notice, focused failure feedback and in-flight submission guard
tests.positive: Configured forms and recovery links render through the existing server/config/SDK boundary; legacy access fallback remains reachable
tests.negative: UX-02 customer access preserves SDK requests, interrupted retry, single submission and incomplete-link recovery
tests.limitation: No successful hosted signup, received-email verification or password reset is claimed. Transport failures are intercepted; authorization success is never mocked. Existing accepted provider contracts remain unchanged.

tests.baseline: Public job pages, native disclosures, global navigation, metadata and canonical/legacy routes
tests.implementation: Shared editorial geometry, native scope disclosures and connected page-section anchors
tests.positive: UX-02 native route disclosures and account recovery keep their real destinations
tests.negative: Existing every-public-link, unsupported-corridor, Escape/focus and anonymous-access regression tests

limitations: Source controls are discovery records, not an expanded action denominator. Unlinked actions and role/state combinations remain NOT_YET_VERIFIED.
Hosted customer received-email lifecycle has not been exercised by this UX release.
Local paint/navigation observations are not field Core Web Vitals.
UX-01 deployment was separately approved and verified. UX-02 is not authorized for merge or deployment by that approval.
